title: AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026 - Apply for 02 Project Clinician Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Patna, has released an official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for Project Clinician Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in MBBS, MD/ MS can grab this chance and apply for the AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026 . Here we have provided more information about the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible candidates can apply before the last...
